title: AxonFlow — Claude Code Usage (Tokens / Cost / Activity by Developer & Session)
description: Aggregate usage from the Claude Code / Cowork OTLP metrics ingest (POST /v1/metrics, Enterprise, v9.5.0+). The usage panels read usage_events rows (event_type = 'claude_code_metric') from PostgreSQL — these counters are NOT Prometheus metrics. metric_value is the delta-normalized increment, so SUM(metric_value) is always correct regardless of the exporter's temporality. The ingest-health row reads the Prometheus counter axonflow_otel_ingest_rejected_total. For per-decision detail (who did what, verdicts, redactions), use the customer portal's decisions feed / audit log — this dashboard is aggregates only.

list.name: org
list.label: Organization
list.description: Org (license) that authenticated the export. Usage rows are org-tagged from the authenticated license, never from the telemetry.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT org_id FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT org_id FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens (input + output)
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.token.usage deltas with type input/output. Cache tokens (cacheRead / cacheCreation) are excluded here — they dwarf real tokens on a typical session — and shown separately in the by-type panel and the developer table.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "tokens" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND metric_attributes->>'type' IN ('input', 'output') AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.cost.usage deltas (USD). metric_value is the exact authority; the estimated_cost_cents mirror column is a rounded integer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "cost_usd" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Active time
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.active_time.total deltas (seconds of active Claude Code use).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "active_seconds" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.active_time.total' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Lines of code changed
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.lines_of_code.count deltas (added + removed; the type attribute distinguishes them).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "lines_changed" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Sessions started
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.session.count deltas (CLI sessions started).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "sessions" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.session.count' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Commits
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.commit.count deltas (git commits created via Claude Code).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "commits" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.commit.count' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Pull requests
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.pull_request.count deltas (PRs created via Claude Code).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "pull_requests" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.pull_request.count' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Edit-tool permission decisions
panels.description: SUM of claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision deltas (accept + reject; split below).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(metric_value), 0) AS "tool_decisions" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time)

panels.title: Token usage by type
panels.description: claude_code.token.usage deltas split by the type attribute (input / output / cacheRead / cacheCreation). Cache reads normally dominate — that is expected Claude Code behavior, not double-counting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(metric_time, $__interval), COALESCE(metric_attributes->>'type', 'unspecified') AS "type", SUM(metric_value) AS "tokens" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(metric_time, $__interval), SUM(metric_value) AS "cost_usd" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Usage by developer
panels.description: Per-developer rollup keyed on the telemetry user.email (attribution label, not an authenticated identity). Rows attribute to '(unattributed — API-key client)' when the exporting client authenticated Anthropic-side with an API key and emitted no user.email.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(user_email, '(unattributed — API-key client)') AS "Developer", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND metric_attributes->>'type' IN ('input', 'output')), 0) AS "Tokens (in+out)", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND metric_attributes->>'type' IN ('cacheRead', 'cacheCreation')), 0) AS "Cache tokens", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.cost.usage'), 0)::numeric, 4) AS "Cost (USD)", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count'), 0) AS "Lines changed", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.commit.count'), 0) AS "Commits", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.pull_request.count'), 0) AS "PRs", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.active_time.total'), 0) AS "Active time (s)", COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Usage by session (top 50 by cost)
panels.description: Per-session rollup keyed on the telemetry session.id. First/last activity are datapoint event times (metric_time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(session_id, '(none)') AS "Session", COALESCE(user_email, '(unattributed)') AS "Developer", MIN(metric_time) AS "First activity", MAX(metric_time) AS "Last activity", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND metric_attributes->>'type' IN ('input', 'output')), 0) AS "Tokens (in+out)", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.cost.usage'), 0)::numeric, 4) AS "Cost (USD)", COALESCE(SUM(metric_value) FILTER (WHERE metric_name = 'claude_code.lines_of_code.count'), 0) AS "Lines changed" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 6 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

panels.title: Edit-tool decisions over time
panels.description: claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision deltas split by the decision attribute (accept / reject). These are Claude Code's local tool-permission prompts — for AxonFlow policy verdicts (allow / deny / needs_approval), see the Claude Code Governance dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(metric_time, $__interval), COALESCE(metric_attributes->>'decision', 'unknown') AS "decision", SUM(metric_value) AS "decisions" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Decisions by tool
panels.description: claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision deltas grouped by the tool_name and decision attributes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(metric_attributes->>'tool_name', '(unknown)') AS "Tool", COALESCE(metric_attributes->>'decision', '(unknown)') AS "Decision", SUM(metric_value) AS "Count" FROM usage_events WHERE event_type = 'claude_code_metric' AND metric_name = 'claude_code.code_edit_tool.decision' AND (${org:sqlstring} = '%' OR org_id = ${org:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(metric_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Rejected exports (since agent start)
panels.description: sum(axonflow_otel_ingest_rejected_total) — every /v1/logs and /v1/metrics request rejected with status >= 400 since the agent started. The raw counter (not increase()) is used so a series born mid-window still counts its first rejects. Non-zero usually means a misconfigured exporter (bad Authorization header, wrong protocol). Scraped from the agent's /prometheus endpoint.

panels.title: Top rejected tenants
panels.description: Attempted Basic-auth org by reject reason, since agent start (raw counter — increase() would miss a series' first rejects). The tenant label is the ATTEMPTED username (bounded set) — corroborate with the agent's [OTELIngest] log lines before concluding a customer-side misconfig.
